arguments.command: export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG:-nothingness_linux_debug}"; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; out=$( .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState ); after=$(echo "$out" | node -pe "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')).songInfo?.path || ''" <<<"$out"); echo "after=$after"; echo "$out" | head -n 3
